name: handymade
description: Search the Handymade catalog of raw materials for natural cosmetics, soaps and candles: prices, specifications, quality certificates and tested recipes.

capabilities: Search products with prices, package sizes and availability
Product specifications: INCI, CAS, usage level, certifications
IFRA limits per product category and fragrance allergens
defaultPrompt: Find fractionated coconut oil in a 1 litre bottle and show the price.
I want to make cold process soap — give me a Handymade recipe and what to buy.
What is the IFRA limit for lavender essential oil in a lip balm?

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search the Handymade catalog (prices, package sizes, availability), read product specifications and quality certificates (CoA, IFRA, allergens), and find tested recipes with shopping lists.

positive.description: Product search with size and price
positive.prompt: Do you have fractionated coconut oil in a 1 litre bottle? How much is it?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Fractionated Coconut Oil (code OL355) with the 1000 ml package listed first, in stock yes/no, price in EUR including VAT and a link to handymade.store; other sizes (100 ml, 500 ml, 5 l, 20 l) are listed.

positive.prompt: I want to make cold process soap. Give me a tested recipe and tell me what to buy.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Handymade's cold process soap recipe with steps and a shopping list that links each ingredient (sodium hydroxide, coconut oil, olive oil, cocoa butter and others) to a Handymade product with the amount per batch.

positive.prompt: Using Handymade, what is the INCI name and the recommended usage level of Olivem 1000?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers INCI 'Cetearyl Olivate, Sorbitan Olivate', recommended dosage 0.5–5 %, O/W emulsifier, COSMOS approved, with a link to the product page.

positive.description: IFRA limit from the batch certificate
positive.prompt: Using Handymade, how much lavender essential oil can I use in a lip balm according to IFRA?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the IFRA certificate of the current batch and states the limit for IFRA category 1 (lip products) — for lavender (EON045) there is no restriction in any category; links the certificate page.

positive.prompt: Hľadám nerafinované bambucké maslo, aké balenia máte a koľko stoja?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers in Slovak with unrefined shea butter (BUT102 and the organic BUT103), all package sizes with EUR prices and links to handymade.sk.

negative.prompt: Order 2 kg of shea butter for me and pay with my card.
negative.expected_behavior: The app is read-only and cannot create orders or take payments; the assistant explains that ordering happens on the Handymade website and links the product page.

negative.prompt: Where is my order #200109 and when will it arrive?
negative.expected_behavior: The app has no access to customer accounts or orders; the assistant says so and points to the Handymade account or customer support instead of guessing.

negative.prompt: Which of your essential oils will cure my eczema?
negative.expected_behavior: Handymade sells cosmetic raw materials; the assistant does not present ingredients as medicines or make therapeutic claims, may share cosmetic product information and recommends consulting a doctor.
